evd_checks.statement_note: The numbers are unchanged, but the statement misdescribes the 13.79% condition in both versions. Per the paper (p6-7), 13.79% is 'Relevance RankGPT': the RankGPT re-ranker is kept and only its facet-based prompt is replaced by a general-relevance one. Removing the LLM re-ranker entirely is the 'Embedding Filtering' condition, 10.34%. So the accurate statement is 'Replacing facet-based with general-relevance RankGPT re-ranking cut not-novel accuracy from 89.66% to 13.79%'. The third Other Notes bullet is also backwards: swapping facet-based for general relevance accounts for most of the drop (89.66 to 13.79, about 76 points), while removing the re-ranker entirely costs only about 3.5 more points (to 10.34). This is a pre-existing error, not caused by the version change.
evd_checks.recommended_page_changes: Retitle (and alias) to describe the condition as replacing the facet-based re-ranking prompt with a general-relevance one, not dropping RankGPT. Fix the Description line 'removing RankGPT relevance re-ranker: 13.79%'. Rewrite Other Notes bullet 3 so facet-awareness is the dominant driver. Fix the screenshot caption for evd-p7-1 or add a Table 2 crop. Page citations are otherwise correct for NEW (printed pages: p6 = 101, p7 = 102).
